```{r}
library(readxl)   # Needed to read .xlsx files
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
#install.packages("igraph")
library(igraph)
#install.packages("ggraph")
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidygraph)
library(tibble)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
```

```{r}
ASV_Isolate_Mapping <- read_excel(
  "~/Tomicro_2025/ASVs_vs_isolates/Isolate_ASV_mapping.xlsx",
  sheet = "Sheet1"
)

ASVs <- read.table(
  "~/Tomicro_2025/16S_Tomicro_2025_Rarefied_Table_1000_times_Clean_ASVnumbers_2.txt",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- read.table(
  "~/Tomicro_2025/Metadata_12_2025.txt",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE
)

```
```{r}
# Mapping: keep only needed columns and drop duplicates
map <- ASV_Isolate_Mapping %>%
  rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, "\\s+", "")) %>%
  # EDIT HERE if your column names differ
  rename(Isolate_ID = Isolate_ID, ASV_ID = ASV_ID, Genus = Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    Isolate_ID = trimws(as.character(Isolate_ID)),
    ASV_ID     = trimws(as.character(ASV_ID)),
    Genus      = trimws(as.character(Genus))
  ) %>%
  distinct(Isolate_ID, ASV_ID, Genus)
```

```{r}
# If your ASV table already has Sample as first column, keep it.
if (!"Sample" %in% colnames(ASVs)) {
  ASVs <- ASVs %>% rownames_to_column("Sample")
}
  ASVs <- ASVs %>% mutate(Sample = as.character(Sample))
  
```
```{r}
meta <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Sample           = as.character(Sample),
    Microcompartment = as.character(Microcompartment),
    Soil_origin      = as.character(Soil_origin),
    Plant_condition  = as.character(Plant_condition),
    Group = paste(Microcompartment, Soil_origin, Plant_condition, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  select(Sample, Microcompartment, Soil_origin, Plant_condition, Group)

```
```{r}
# 3) ALIGN SAMPLES BETWEEN ASV TABLE AND METADATA
# ----------------------------
common_samples <- intersect(ASVs$Sample, meta$Sample)
if (length(common_samples) < 2) stop("Too few overlapping samples between ASVs and metadata.")

ASVs2 <- ASVs %>% filter(Sample %in% common_samples)
meta2 <- meta %>% filter(Sample %in% common_samples)

# ----------------------------
# 4) IDENTIFY ASV COLUMNS + CHECK MATCH WITH MAPPING
# ----------------------------
asv_cols <- grep("^ASV", colnames(ASVs2), value = TRUE)
if (length(asv_cols) == 0) stop("No ASV columns detected (expected colnames like ASV11, ASV235, ...).")

matched_asvs <- unique(map$ASV_ID)
overlap_asvs <- intersect(asv_cols, matched_asvs)

cat("ASV columns in table:", length(asv_cols), "\n")
cat("ASVs in mapping:", length(matched_asvs), "\n")
cat("Overlap:", length(overlap_asvs), "\n")

if (length(overlap_asvs) == 0) stop("No overlap between mapping ASVs and ASV table column names.")

# ----------------------------
# 5) CONVERT RAREFIED COUNTS -> RELATIVE ABUNDANCE (%)
# ----------------------------
ASVs_RA <- ASVs2 %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(asv_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(asv_cols), ~ 100 * .x / total)) %>%
  select(-total)

# ----------------------------
# 6) LONG FORMAT + GROUP JOIN
# ----------------------------
asv_long <- ASVs_RA %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(asv_cols), names_to = "ASV_ID", values_to = "RA") %>%
  mutate(ASV_ID = trimws(as.character(ASV_ID))) %>%
  left_join(meta2 %>% select(Sample, Group), by = "Sample")

# Sanity: ensure group exists
if (all(is.na(asv_long$Group))) stop("Group join failed: Sample IDs do not match between ASVs_RA and meta2.")

# ----------------------------
# 7) MEAN RA PER ASV PER GROUP (only matched ASVs)
# ----------------------------
asv_group_mean <- asv_long %>%
  filter(ASV_ID %in% overlap_asvs) %>%
  group_by(ASV_ID, Group) %>%
  summarise(mean_RA = mean(RA, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

if (nrow(asv_group_mean) == 0) stop("No rows in asv_group_mean. Something is wrong with ASV filtering.")

# ----------------------------
# 8) AGGREGATE TO ISOLATE LEVEL (sum across its ASVs)
# ----------------------------
iso_group_mean <- map %>%
  filter(ASV_ID %in% overlap_asvs) %>%
  left_join(asv_group_mean, by = "ASV_ID") %>%
  group_by(Isolate_ID, Genus, Group) %>%
  summarise(mean_RA = sum(mean_RA, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ----------------------------
# 9) MATRIX FOR HEATMAP (rows = isolates, cols = groups)
# ----------------------------
mat_df <- iso_group_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_RA, values_fill = 0)

mat <- mat_df %>% select(-Isolate_ID, -Genus) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$Isolate_ID

# Check variation (prevents colorRamp2 error)
rng <- range(mat, finite = TRUE)
if (rng[1] == rng[2]) {
  stop("Heatmap matrix has no variation (all values identical). Check earlier steps; likely zero signal after filtering.")
}

# ----------------------------
# 10) ROW ANNOTATIONS (Genus + number of ASVs per isolate)
# ----------------------------
n_asv <- map %>% filter(ASV_ID %in% overlap_asvs) %>% count(Isolate_ID, name = "n_ASVs")#Counts how many ASVs map to each isolate

row_anno <- mat_df %>%#Creates a table with one row per isolate:
  select(Isolate_ID, Genus) %>%
  left_join(n_asv, by = "Isolate_ID") %>%
  distinct()

ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Genus = row_anno$Genus,
  annotation_name_side = "top"
)

# ----------------------------
# 11) COLORS + HEATMAP
# ----------------------------
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = c(rng[1], (rng[1] + rng[2]) / 2, rng[2]),
  colors = c("#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#08519c")
)

library(vegan)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Mean relative abundance (%)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_rows = function(x) vegan::vegdist(x, method = "bray"),
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  column_names_rot = 37,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_max_width = unit(4, "cm"),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Mean relative abundance (%)",
    title_position = "leftcenter-rot"   
  ),
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "grey85", lwd = 0.2),
   width = unit(12, "cm")  # ← faint grid lines
)

pdf("~/Tomicro_2025/ASVs_vs_isolates/heatmap_isolates_mean_RA.pdf",
    width = 12, height = 6)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left"
)

dev.off()
#Colors represent mean relative abundance (%), calculated from rarefied counts and averaged across samples within each compartment × soil × health-status group. The color scale reflects the observed range of values (0–5 %).
 
 #save as png
  png(
  "heatmap_isolates_mean_RA.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left"
)

dev.off()
```
